name: Clascoterone
lead: Clascoterone (Winlevi) is a topical antiandrogen cream approved by the FDA in 2020 for acne in patients aged 12 and older, notable as the first new acne drug class in decades. A solution is being investigated for androgenetic alopecia.
Phase 3 trials showed greater lesion reduction than vehicle, and real-world case series report similar results.

paras: It competes with dihydrotestosterone for androgen receptors in sebaceous glands and hair follicles, blocking local androgen signalling without much systemic effect.

Local redness, dryness and itching are most common. Rare, reversible suppression of the adrenal axis was seen under maximal-use conditions, so caution is advised in young patients. It is prescription-only, and its hair-loss use remains investigational.
